ModMetaData.name: TailorMade: Race Restriction Fix
ModMetaData.author: deepseek
ModMetaData.description:
[h1]TailorMade: Race Restriction Fix[/h1] Fixes a bug where the [b]Unlock Race-Restricted Apparel[/b] setting in TailorMade has no effect — cross-race clothing restrictions cannot be restored even when the setting is turned off.
[hr][h2]The Bug[/h2] TailorMade ships an XML patch (Patches/TailorMade_UnlockRaceRestrictedApparel.xml) that unconditionally clears HAR race restriction data at game load time. This runs regardless of the [b]unlockRestrictedApparel[/b] mod setting, making the toggle a dead switch — turning it off does NOT re-enable restrictions.
[hr][h2]What This Fix Does[/h2] [list] [*]Adds runtime Harmony checks that properly respect the [b]unlockRestrictedApparel[/b] setting [*]When the setting is OFF, restricts cross-race clothing for HAR alien races based on mod origin [*]When the setting is ON, behaves identically to TailorMade's original unlock behavior [*]Does NOT modify any TailorMade files — safe to use, easy to remove [/list]
[hr][h2]Installation[/h2] [list][*]Place this mod [b]after[/b] TailorMade in your mod list[/list]
